evals.name: own-business-invariant
evals.prompt: Implement a bank account withdrawal capability ensuring balance cannot drop below zero.
evals.expected_output: Domain entity method enforcing the balance invariant and returning domain-specific InsufficientFunds error.
assertions: Business invariant is checked and enforced inside the domain model.
Returns custom domain error when invariant is violated.
Does not import HTTP, database driver, or serialization packages.

evals.name: domain-port-inversion
evals.prompt: Define the persistence contract for a User entity in hexagonal architecture.
evals.expected_output: UserRepository interface defined in the domain/core package, tailored to domain needs.
assertions: Interface is defined in the domain/core layer and accepted by usecase constructors.
Methods accept and return domain entities and domain error types.
Database technology details (SQL, pgx, Redis) are completely absent from the port.

evals.name: infrastructure-isolation
evals.prompt: Review a proposed core service method that receives an *http.Request and *sql.Tx directly.
evals.expected_output: Refactoring that extracts HTTP parameters into plain domain command struct and moves transaction to UoW adapter.
assertions: Replaces *http.Request with a pure domain DTO or command object.
Replaces *sql.Tx with domain UnitOfWork or repository abstraction.
Core package remains 100% free of external protocol and driver imports.
